implemented_requirements.evidence: Tetris.spawn() creates a new Piece at y = 0; gui.tick() calls game.step() which moves the piece down with game.move(0, 1) based on drop_interval().

implemented_requirements.requirement: Player can move left/right before pieces land
implemented_requirements.evidence: gui.key() maps "left" and "right" keys to game.move(-1) and game.move(1) respectively.

implemented_requirements.requirement: Player can rotate pieces before they land
implemented_requirements.evidence: gui.key() maps "up" key to game.rotate_piece(), which rotates the piece with wall‑kick handling.
Tetris.lock() builds a list of non‑full rows (remaining) and inserts cleared empty rows at the top, effectively removing full lines.

implemented_requirements.requirement: Scoring increases with cleared lines and drops
implemented_requirements.evidence: Tetris.lock() adds LINE_SCORES[cleared] * level to self.score; hard_drop adds 2 * cells dropped; soft drop adds 1 per cell in gui.key().

implemented_requirements.requirement: Game ends when no more pieces can be placed
implemented_requirements.evidence: Tetris.spawn() sets self.game_over = True if collides(self.piece, 0, 0) after spawning a new piece.

implemented_requirements.requirement: Board updates after each move or drop
implemented_requirements.evidence: gui.draw() reads game.board and game.piece.cells() each tick and after every key event, redrawing the canvas.

implemented_requirements.requirement: All seven standard Tetromino shapes are included
implemented_requirements.evidence: SHAPES dictionary in tetris.py defines 'I','O','T','S','Z','J','L' with their matrices.

implemented_requirements.requirement: Drop speed increases as the game progresses
implemented_requirements.evidence: Tetris.drop_interval() returns max(0.08, 0.6 - 0.05 * (self.level - 1)); level rises with lines cleared.
